meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية

paper:
Sofiane is a middle school pupil. Every day, he wakes up at 6:30. He washes his face, gets dressed and has breakfast with his family. He goes to school by bus. Classes start at 8:00. After school, he plays football with his friends, then he does his homework. He usually goes to bed at 9:30.

A. Reading (7 points)

  1. Answer: a) What time does Sofiane wake up?   b) How does he go to school?
  2. Put these actions in order: does his homework — has breakfast — plays football.

B. Language (7 points)

  1. Put the verbs in the present simple: She (watch) TV every evening.   We (not / go) to school on Friday.
  2. Classify the final "-s": washes — plays — gets.
    /s//z//ɪz/
       
  3. Ask a question: "He goes to bed at 9:30."

C. Written expression (6 points)

Write 5 sentences about your daily routine. Use: first, then, after that, finally.
solution:
A. Reading

  1. a) He wakes up at 6:30.   b) He goes to school by bus.
  2. has breakfast → plays football → does his homework

B. Language

  1. She watches TV every evening. We don't go to school on Friday.
  2. /s//z//ɪz/
    getsplayswashes
  3. What time does he go to bed?

C. Written expression (example)

First, I wake up at seven. Then, I have breakfast with my sister. After that, I walk to school. In the afternoon, I do my homework. Finally, I go to bed at ten.
